item.text: The setup uses the stock-shortage post and the pricing post, with pharmacy-related keyword targeting restricted to Ireland and the UK. The two ad groups have lifetime caps totaling $350 and will end at midnight Dublin time after 19 August. I’m activating them under your launch authorization.

Day 1 spent $20.22 and generated 6 link clicks. The stock-shortage post has the lower cost per click so far, but the sample is small. I’m keeping the test running for another day before shifting budget.
After two days, the stock-shortage post costs $2.54 per link click versus $4.10 for the pricing post. I’ve shifted the budget split to 70/30 in its favour, keeping the combined lifetime cap at $350.
The pricing post added no link clicks on day 3. I’ve paused it and moved the available budget toward the stock-shortage post, which has generated 16 clicks at $2.48 each.
Day 4 totals: $70.52 spent and 25 link clicks. The active post is still producing clicks at roughly its earlier cost; I’m keeping the pharmacy targeting and budget settings unchanged today.
Day 5 totals: $99.14 spent and 33 link clicks. The latest day’s clicks became more expensive, so I’ve set a $3 maximum click bid and will check how it affects delivery tomorrow.
The bid cap reduced delivery to one click today. I’ve restored automatic bidding to recover volume. Total spend is $100.97 for 34 link clicks.

At halfway, spend is $126.10 for 41 link clicks. Delivery recovered with automatic bidding. I’ve raised daily pacing to $32 to make more of the remaining budget available during the final week; lifetime caps still total $350.

item.text: Day 8 added 9 link clicks for $26.85, bringing totals to $152.95 and 50 clicks. Cost per click improved from yesterday, so I’m holding the current settings.
Day 9 totals: $183.86 spent and 62 link clicks. Today added 12 clicks at $2.58 each. Delivery and pacing look steady; no changes today.

With four days remaining, spend is $198.19 for 67 link clicks. I’ve released the paused ad group’s unused allowance to the active post and raised daily pacing to $38. The combined cap remains exactly $350.
Day 11 totals: $238.68 spent and 79 link clicks. There’s $111.32 left under the overall cap for the final three days. I’m keeping the current setup running.
Day 12 totals: $275.57 spent and 91 link clicks. Today added 12 clicks at $3.07 each. The remaining $74.43 is available for the last two days.
Entering the final day: $303.94 spent and 100 link clicks. I’ve made the remaining $46.06 available today. The ads are scheduled to end at midnight Dublin time tonight.
The campaign has ended on schedule, and I’ve paused it and the remaining active ad group. I’ll check the reported totals once more before sending the short recap.

Campaign finished: 6–19 August, Dublin time. All ads are paused.

- Spend: **$347.99 USD** of $350
- Impressions: **408,206**
- Link clicks: **113**

Targeted Ireland and the UK only; shifted budget toward the stock-shortage post. Booked demos remain unmeasured here because there’s no pixel or access to your booking data.
